cluster_quality.source: canonical deck path verified against the pinned registry
cluster_quality.template: conservatively co-clustered within each deck; cross-deck template similarity unreviewed
cluster_quality.entity: source-item identity unresolved; a deck-specific placeholder is not an entity de-duplication proof

cells.public_answer_exposure: Published upstream tasks and answers are discoverable; this split alone cannot be a sealed hidden exam.

source.license_conflict: Paper CC-BY-SA-4.0; dataset card MIT; do not redistribute assets

cluster_quality.source: identical golden-response workbook paths grouped as one family
cluster_quality.template: conservatively co-clustered within each golden workbook; cross-family template similarity unreviewed
cluster_quality.entity: issuer/project identity cannot be reliably inferred from all source paths; a family-specific placeholder is not an entity de-duplication proof

prior_gui_control.status: human GUI partial/full/manual-reset control on one distinct workbook

cells.public_answer_exposure: Published upstream tasks and answers are discoverable; this split alone cannot be a sealed hidden exam.

contract.owner: independent evaluator; actor cannot write contracts, reference files, or receipts
per_task_evidence_required: pinned source and source-family lineage, including license review
fresh isolated Microsoft web document created from source input; immutable original file hash
untouched GUI open/edit-mode/save/reload/download and Office-normalized baseline hash
frozen task-specific oracle, allowlisted normalizations, and output path before candidate action
visible GUI known-positive action sequence with action/time budget and saved-file readback
task-specific target outcome plus unrelated-content/structure preservation
wrong-answer or partial-answer negative and unrelated-edit negative, both rejected
changed same-file state restored to initial semantic state and independently re-read, followed by a fresh-copy reset test
independent hidden input perturbation where a formula or data dependency is claimed
source/template/entity overlap review against train and selection and prior published task exposure

actor_visible: source document in original Microsoft web app
evaluator_only: final candidate identities until task closure

contract.result_policy: Infrastructure failures remain unscored; no score is assigned from a screenshot or upstream rubric alone. Candidate count never substitutes for individually audited GUI admission.
contract.preflight_policy: Byte and declaration preflight remains pending independent origin and task-specific oracle audit; it cannot itself admit a task.
